name: AudioCodes Ltd.
summary: AudioCodes Ltd. provides voice communications solutions for enterprises, contact centers, and service providers in the United States, Europe, Eastern Asia, and Israel. The company offers voice networking infrastructure and devices; cloud-based platforms and management solutions; and Voice AI applications. It also provides AudioCodes Live Platform, a cloud-based service delivery platform that enables the provisioning, management, and operation of voice connectivity and AI-based communication services across communications and contact center environments; Meeting Insights, an enterprise solution that enables users to record audio and video meeting generated content and creates meeting minutes …
